description: This Java source file defines the CustomerController class for managing customer-related operations within an admin web interface of an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for viewing, editing, saving, listing, and resetting customer passwords, along with associated helper methods and dependencies.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Controller class managing customer CRUD and related operations, including viewing, editing, listing, and password reset functionalities within an admin interface.

methods.name: displayCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET request to show customer details page; loads customer data for editing or initializes new customer.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update customer data after validation.

methods.name: pageCustomers
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request for paginated fetching of customers based on search criteria.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST request to reset a customer's password, generate a new one, encode it, save, and email to customer.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper to set menu and active navigation elements.

methods.name: getCustomerOptions
methods.description: Loads customer options and populates model for the customer details view.
